script.content:
set -euo pipefail
dockerfile=$(jq -er '.inputs.dockerfile' "$DEVOPS_INPUT_FILE")
context=$(jq -er '.inputs.context' "$DEVOPS_INPUT_FILE")
repository=$(jq -er '.context.image.repository' "$DEVOPS_INPUT_FILE")
run_id=$(jq -er '.context.run.id' "$DEVOPS_INPUT_FILE")
job_key=$(jq -er '.context.job.key' "$DEVOPS_INPUT_FILE")
metadata_file=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$metadata_file"' EXIT
docker buildx build --push --file "$dockerfile" --tag "${repository}:${run_id}-${job_key}" --metadata-file "$metadata_file" -- "$context"
digest=$(jq -er '."containerimage.digest"' "$metadata_file")
jq -n --arg image_ref "${repository}@${digest}" --arg image_digest "$digest" '{image_ref: $image_ref, image_digest: $image_digest}' > "$DEVOPS_OUTPUT_FILE"
